tensions.body: Our roadmap tool has no consistent way to express which customer problem a product area exists to serve, so every planning cycle re-litigates the mapping from scratch. I want to restructure how intent is represented in the tool, but I have been holding it because it feels like the kind of change that ought to be agreed somewhere first. Nothing has moved on this in a long time.

When a release slips, it is unclear who decides whether to cut scope or move the date. Delivery Operations runs the train but does not own the scope call, and no role holds that decision explicitly. This has come up in three separate releases.

Build times have roughly doubled since we added the integration suite, and nobody owns deciding what runs on every commit versus nightly. Two circles down from the Product Circle, so a root-level sweep will not see this tension at all.
